emails.subject: Re: Welcome to BIFA, and a question on quoting
emails.html:
Hello,

Last week I wrote to you about Kazinga and the air, sea and road enquiries International Freight Solutions has to price as it grows. It uses AI to read each incoming request, prices it from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply for your team to check and send. Your data is stored in the EU and encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it.

Would a 20-minute demo in English over the next couple of weeks be useful?

Kind regards,
